john3.1.p1.b1.text: The elder, To the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth:

john3.1.p1.b2.text: For I was overjoyed when the brothers came and testified about your devotion to the truth, in which you continue to walk.

john3.1.p1.b3.text: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.

john3.1.p1.b4.text: Beloved, I pray that in every way you may prosper and enjoy good health, as your soul also prospers.

john3.1.p2.b1.text: Beloved, you are faithful in what you are doing for the brothers, and especially since they are strangers to you.

john3.1.p2.b2.text: … You will do well to send them on their way in a manner worthy of God.

john3.1.p2.b3.text: For they went out on behalf of the Name, accepting nothing from the Gentiles.

john3.1.p2.b4.text: Therefore we ought to support such men, so that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

john3.1.p3.b1.text: I have written to the church about this, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first, will not accept our instruction.

john3.1.p3.b2.text: … he refuses to welcome the brothers and forbids those who want to do so …

john3.1.p3.b3.text: … even putting them out of the church.

john3.1.p4.b1.text: Beloved, do not imitate what is evil, but what is good. …

john3.1.p4.b2.text: … The one who does good is of God; the one who does evil has not seen God.

john3.1.p4.b3.text: Demetrius has received a good testimony from everyone, and from the truth itself. …

john3.1.p4.b4.text: … We also testify for him, and you know that our testimony is true.

john3.1.p5.b1.text: I have many things to write to you, but I would prefer not to do so with pen and ink.

john3.1.p5.b2.text: Instead, I hope to see you soon and speak with you face to face. …

john3.1.p5.b3.text: … Peace to you. The friends here send you greetings. …

john3.1.p5.b4.text: … Greet each of our friends there by name.
